headline: Planning and Development Coordinator
summary: Planning and development coordinator with twelve years in public planning in Maguindanao del Sur. I lead the preparation of development plans and investment programs, turn policies into projects, and set up performance monitoring and risk reporting so leaders see results. I manage a team of seven planners and analysts.
highlights: Led the lake-basin development plan that secured funding for 18 flood-control and livelihood projects.
Built a performance scorecard for 30 programs, reviewed by the board every quarter.
Introduced quarterly risk reports that flagged delayed projects months earlier.
skills: Support to executives and the board

experience.title: Planning and Development Coordinator
bullets: Lead a team of seven preparing the authority's development plan and annual investment program.
Monitor 30 programs against targets and present results and risks to the board.
Prepare physical and financial accomplishment reports for oversight agencies.

experience.title: Planning Officer
bullets: Analysed data on flooding, farming and poverty to set project priorities.
Drafted policy papers and resolutions for council members.
